        Technical info 
        
    
    
  
        
  
        
    
    
        
    
    
  
        
  
        
    
        What is Stalak?
        
    
        Stalak is a lip-sync video editor for rappers and singers.
    Drop in your song and a few videos of you performing it, and Stalak cuts between your takes on the beat,
    with the lip sync locked in. Export for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, or a full 16:9 music video for YouTube.
        
    
        No download. No sign-up. 3 steps and you’re ready to post. Stalak runs right in your browser on iPhone, Android or desktop. It’s free, and you don’t need an account.
        
    
        How to make a lip-sync video with Stalak:
        
    
          
      
        • Upload your song.
          • 
      
        • Add a few takes of you performing it. Film them ahead of time, or right in Stalak’s camera.
          • 
      
        • Stalak cuts between your takes on the beat. Hit export and post.
          • 
    
        
    
        What you can do:
        
    
          
      
        • Auto cuts on the beat, on every word or every bar.
          • 
      
        • On-screen lyrics, one line at a time; word-by-word and karaoke styles with Stalak Pro.
          • 
      
        • Auto lyrics: Stalak writes and syncs your lyrics from your vocals (Stalak Pro).
          • 
      
        • 16:9 music video mode for YouTube, with effects like flash, zoom, shake and slow-mo (Stalak Pro).
          • 
      
        • Video packs: 5 to 30 differently cut videos from one song, from just 2 takes (Creator Plus).
          • 
      
        • Everything happens in your browser, so your videos stay on your device. The only exceptions: your cloud projects, saved automatically with Creator Plus, and the audio sent for auto lyrics.
          •

              What Pro does for you
              • Your music video, ready for YouTube
                No more hours in editing software. Import your song and your takes, and Stalak edits the whole track in 16:9: cuts on the beat, lips perfectly in sync, effects. All that’s left is to post.
              • Post every day, effortlessly
                A pack is 5, 10 or 30 all-different videos from the same song, made in one go. Enough to feed your TikTok and Reels for a month, from a single session.
              • Your video, your signature
                Without the Stalak logo, your videos end on you. It looks pro, and your name is the one people remember.
              • Lyrics people sing along to
                Karaoke lights up with your voice, word after word, big or subtle. Viewers read along, sing with you and remember your hook.

              Questions
              
          
              Monthly or yearly, what’s the difference?
              None in the app: you get your whole plan either way. Yearly costs less: $49.99 instead of $95.88 for Pro, $99.99 instead of $179.88 for Creator Plus.
              
          
              Can I stop anytime?
              Yes. Cancel in two clicks from your account: you keep your plan until the end of the paid period, then go back to Free. Your projects saved online are no longer accessible, but we keep them for 6 months: they come back if you get Creator Plus again.
              
          
              What if I don’t like it?
              You get a full refund if you ask within 14 days of a payment. See the refund policy.
              
          
              How do I pay?
              By card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or PayPal. Payments are handled by Paddle.com, our authorized reseller, which also sends the invoices. Prices are in dollars; Paddle adds your country’s taxes at checkout.
              
          
              Are my videos sent to your servers?
              No: editing and export happen on your device. Only the projects you choose to save online (Creator Plus) are kept in your account, privately.
